title: Coconut Says Tok Tok | Fun Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
Nariyal Nanu sits up high, but inside he holds sweet, cool water to share!
This cheerful song teaches kids that asking for help from Papa and working together can open even the hardest things.
Sing along, tap your hands, and join the Tok Tok fun!

Nariyal Nanu sits up high and tall
Hairy brown all over, with a sweet little grin
I have water inside me, cool, cool, cool
Sweet inside, come and see!

Tok tok, coconut, tok tok, tok
Knock, knock, knock, knock, open up the door and let me out
Sweet water inside, sweet water inside
Tok tok, tok tok, tok tok, tok!

Way too hard, way too hard, the shell just will not crack
Little sister tries, and tries, and tries, and tries again
"Papa, Papa, come and help us, please, please!"
Safe and slow, so carefully, we'll open it right now

Tok tok, coconut, tok tok, tok
Knock, knock, knock, knock, open up the door and let me out
Sweet water inside, sweet water inside
Tok tok, tok tok, tok tok, tok!

Papa taps it, tok, tok, tok
Crack, crack, crack, crack, the top goes flying off
Splash, splash, splash, splash
Happy, happy, oh what a lovely day!

Tok tok, coconut, tok tok, tok
Knock, knock, knock, knock, open up the door and let me out
Sweet water inside, sweet water inside
Tok tok, tok tok, tok tok, tok!

Everyone drinks, slurp, slurp, slurp
Cool and sweet, oh it's so very nice
Thank you, thank you, our darling Nanu dear
Tok tok, now we're all done, bye bye, bye!
